title: Refuse an unknown hook name before the blocking stdin read
action: In try_native (hooks/mod.rs), validate the hook name against HOOK_NAMES before read_stdin_once; unknown name refuses on argv alone, so a caller with an open silent stdin can no longer hang
description: Move the unknown-name refusal above the read_stdin_once() call using the existing HOOK_NAMES const; the match's _ arm becomes unreachable. Existing test without_the_marker_the_same_invocation_reaches_dispatch keeps asserting the FAILURE exit and now cannot block on stdin.
acceptance: bee hook <unknown> exits FAILURE without reading stdin; hooks tests green
judge_obligation_ack: argv-check reorder only; refusal behavior and every guard body unchanged, covered by the existing dispatch tests

trace.outcome: unknown hook names are refused before the stdin read; the hang path is gone

report.outcome: unknown hook names are refused before the stdin read; the hang path is gone
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee hooks::tests — green — 7 dispatch tests cover the reordered path incl. the formerly hanging one
